envelope: Frozen production adjacent-frame full-band log-magnitude spectral flux and normalization, bias 3*WIN/4/sampleRate
originalCandidate: Frozen v563 fullCandidateAbsoluteMs; objects without it remain missing
localRule: Among envelope frame times in [originalPeakAbsoluteMs-10, originalPeakAbsoluteMs], choose the maximum adjacent-frame signed slope env[i]-env[i-1], ties earliest; refined onset is the slope interval midpoint (i-0.5)*hopMs+biasMs
calibration: Recompute E5 opposite-fold same-song unweighted median from raw refined absolute errors; minimum 3 pairs, fallback 0 ms; never reuse original full-peak correction
primaryMetric: Population-weighted clear+approximate +/-5 ms correct rate using absolute candidate time, with missing candidates incorrect
guardrailMetric: Candidate coverage and noClearCandidateOutputRate must remain identical because no candidate is added or removed

hypotheses.H1: E7 rising-edge refinement with recalibration improves weighted audible +/-5 ms correct rate over E5
hypotheses.H2: Relative to E5, E7 fixes more weighted errors than it breaks and sample-044 remains at least 80%
hypotheses.H3: Raw refined candidates are deterministic from audio and frozen peaks; calibration uses only opposite-fold labels

testPolicy: Exactly one rising-edge rule and one recalibration; no search over windows, slope thresholds, interpolation modes, per-redline fitting or fusion
confirmationSetPolicy: Do not read confirmation audio, candidates or labels
